source: derived: horizons marched over the LOLA LDEM 75S 240 m heights at 30 cells and 24 azimuths; Earth direction from the JPL DE440 ephemerides every 6 h of 2027 (libration included)
note: Share of 2027 with the Earth above the regional horizon, at about 2.4 km per cell. The Earth is a point at infinity (Earth parallax of about 1 degree and the solar disc are neglected) and relief smaller than a cell is not resolved. Not validated against NASA illumination products. Cells within 72 km of the rim and cells with an unreadable height have no data.
